_note: Fixed items of the HART Railroad Layout Editor panel that the schematic does not draw; tools/schematic/panel_items.py reads and places them. Kept by hand. First written 2026-11-17 from the approved staging candidate's placements (build_layout_le.py --levels staging --as-live), so the device-map path puts them where that candidate has them. The status cluster keeps the names panel_status.py looks for. The panel's attributes and drawing options were copied from staging_le/panel.json (the hand-drawn panel's); the build sets its name, place and size.

items.note: panel_status.py finds these by name: sensor icons Bridge HBLOOP, SML Mode and Track Power, signal head icon IH9990. Each caption stands by its right edge (right: 76), 4 px left of the lamps at dx 80, its width measured as JMRI on the Pi draws it (pi_dialog), so the four line up there; the dx values they had guessed the widths and did not line up in the Pi's DejaVu Sans (owner, 2026-11-21)
